newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Four Dubai cargoes awarded in India's March tender.
newsitem.headline: Four Dubai cargoes awarded in India's March tender.

text.p: India has awarded four cargoes of Dubai crude in its March buying tender, traders said on Monday.
The cargoes were awarded against first half Dubai quotes.

They said two cargoes were awarded to Statoil at quotes plus 43 and plus 47 cents, one cargo to Wall Street trader Morgan Stanley around quotes plus 45 cents and one cargo to Shell between quotes plus 47 and 55, traders said.
As reported on Friday, two very large crude carriers (VLCCs) of Qua Iboe were awarded. Traders on Monday said the VLCCs were awarded to trader Glencore around dated Brent plus $1.03.
A VLCC of Palanca crude was awarded to French major Elf at dated Brent plus 68 cents, traders said.
In its February buying tender, India awarded one Dubai cargo and two VLCCs of Qua Iboe.
